name: notes
description: Non-normative implementation guidance, edge cases, cross-references, or clarifying commentary.

aiGuidance.purpose: Non-normative commentary attached to a record: implementation tips, edge cases, migration hints, cross-references. Nothing here binds an implementation.
aiGuidance.extraction: Keep it short and keep each note to one observation. Notes earn their place by saying something the normative text deliberately leaves out — a trap, a compatibility caveat, a pointer to the record that handles the related case. If a note grows into an explanation of its own, it has become a `concept` record or a child record; move it.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Never normative — no RFC 2119 keywords. A requirement hidden in a note will not be implemented and cannot be tested. No headings, code blocks or tables: an illustration goes in an `example` record, a matrix in a `table` record. Not a changelog and not a to-do list; history belongs to the record's lineage and open work to the issue tracker.
